criterion: On the Afterglow French drop page every decorative sticker is a flat fill inside a black keyline, drawn from amber, orange, soft cyan, pink or deep teal, and every heading, paragraph and price sits on a section ground rather than on an orange or cyan sticker fill.
evaluation_rule: The stickers are the decorative bolts, arcs, speckled discs, stars and the triangle around the hero at the top of /afterglow/fr/ and around the artist section headed Salut, je suis Tove Ardenne. Yes when each sticker is filled with flat colour, speckles on a speckled disc included, with a black outline around it, when the fills come from an acid amber, an orange, a soft cyan blue, a pink or the deep teal of the hero triangle, and when every heading, paragraph and price on the page sits on a section ground rather than on top of an orange or cyan sticker. No when a sticker has no black outline, when a sticker is shaded with a gradient or a drop shadow, when a sticker is a photograph or an emoji, or when any heading, paragraph or price is printed over an orange or cyan sticker fill.

criterion: The studio pages carry a top navigation reading Campaigns, Audit and, for the owner, Grants, with the signed-in email and Sign out at the right, over quiet flat surfaces free of the public page's stickers, collage and display type.
evaluation_rule: Sign in at /studio/login as owner@example.com with the password deku-demo-pw-2026 and open /studio/ and /studio/audit/, then sign in as editor@example.com and open /studio/. Yes when every studio page has a navigation bar across the top with the links Campaigns and Audit, when the owner also sees Grants and the editor does not, when the signed-in email and a Sign out control sit at the right end of that bar, and when the studio pages show plain panels and tables with no decorative stickers, no tilted cards, no collage photographs and no display-size headlines. No when the navigation sits in a sidebar, when a label differs, when the editor sees Grants, when the email or Sign out is missing, or when a studio page carries the public page's stickers, collage or giant display type.

criterion: Scrolling the Afterglow English drop page passes from a near-white hero to a muted magenta tagline and collage, a pink-cast collection section, a near-white artist section, a muted magenta story section and a near-white footer, in that order.
evaluation_rule: Scroll /afterglow/en/ from the top to the bottom. The collection section is the one headed The collection, the artist section is the one headed Hi, I am Tove Ardenne, the story section is the one headed The RX2K story, and the footer is the numbered product list and legal links at the end; the ground behind the lookbook is not judged. Yes when the hero sits on a near-white ground with a faint green cast, when the tagline and the collage headline sit on a light muted magenta, when the collection cards sit on a very pale pink-cast ground, when the artist section returns to the near-white ground with an orange sun form, when the story section is muted magenta again, and when the footer list and legal links end on the near-white ground with the footer list's product names running across the full width in a heavy condensed display type. No when every section shares one ground, when the footer names are set at body size, when the hero or the collection sits on the magenta, when the order of grounds differs from that sequence, or when a ground is a saturated colour other than the muted magenta.

criterion: Each market row in the studio campaign view for Afterglow shows its status as a spelled word inside a chip whose colour follows the status meaning, a mark distinguishing live markets, and the current legal and owner approvals.
evaluation_rule: Sign in at /studio/login as owner@example.com with the password deku-demo-pw-2026 and open /studio/campaigns/afterglow/ on a wide screen. Yes when the campaign list sits in a narrow pane at the left with the Afterglow market rows beside it on the right, when every market row carries a chip spelling its status word such as published, approved, in_review, draft or unpublished, when a status in progress such as in_review wears the acid amber and a finished state such as published wears the deep teal, when fr and en carry a visible live mark that it, de, es, be-nl and be-fr lack, and when each row names which of the legal and owner approvals are current. No when the campaign list and the market rows are stacked on a wide screen, when a status is shown by colour alone with no word, when every chip wears the same colour, when live markets cannot be told apart from the rest, or when the approvals are missing from the rows.

criterion: Adding a string on the studio market page for Dusk Parade Germany opens a new editable row inside the translations table itself, with the page address and the table staying in place.
evaluation_rule: Sign in at /studio/login as owner@example.com with the password deku-demo-pw-2026, open /studio/campaigns/dusk-parade/markets/de/, and press Add on the translations table, then enter the key promo.note with the value Nur online and press Save. Yes when a new blank row appears inside that same table with inputs for the key and the value, when the address of the page stays the same, when no dialog, overlay or slide-over panel covers the page, and when after saving the new row stays in the table at the same scroll position. No when Add opens a dialog, a slide-over panel or a different page, when the new row appears outside the table, or when saving reloads the whole page to the top.

criterion: The open overlay menu of the Afterglow English drop page fills the viewport on a light muted teal ground and lays the four section names out four across on a wide screen, each name carrying a strip of tape as decoration.
evaluation_rule: Open /afterglow/en/ on a wide screen and press the menu button at the left of the top bar. Yes when the menu covers the whole viewport on a light, muted teal ground, when the four names The collection, Hi, I am Tove Ardenne, The RX2K story and Lookbook sit side by side in one row of four, and when each name carries a strip that looks like a piece of tape. No when the menu is a dropdown or a side drawer that leaves the page visible, when the ground is white, black or the page's own ground, when the four names stack in one column on the wide screen, or when no tape decoration appears.

criterion: Pressing a studio step shows a busy state on that same button for as long as the request runs, and the toast slides in at the top right of the viewport and fades away by itself.
evaluation_rule: Sign in at /studio/login as owner@example.com with the password deku-demo-pw-2026, open /studio/campaigns/dusk-parade/markets/de/, save the shop.cta translation row with the value Shop, then press Submit. Yes when the pressed control shows a busy state such as a spinner, a label change or a disabled look during the request, when the outcome appears as a small message sliding in at the top right corner of the viewport, and when that message leaves by itself without a click. No when nothing on the pressed control changes during the request, when the message appears in the page flow or at the bottom, or when the message stays until someone dismisses it.

criterion: The studio market page for Afterglow Italy stacks its blocks in a fixed order: status and approvals on top, then the translations table, then the availability and price table, then the artifact list with rollback.
evaluation_rule: Sign in at /studio/login as owner@example.com with the password deku-demo-pw-2026 and open /studio/campaigns/afterglow/markets/it/. Yes when the top of the page shows the market status and the approvals before any table, when the translations table with its key, value and status columns comes next, when the availability and price table comes after the translations, and when the list of published artifact versions with a rollback control comes last. No when a table appears above the status block, when the price table comes before the translations, or when the artifact list is missing or sits above the tables.

criterion: Pointing at a product card in the collection section of the Afterglow French drop page engages an overlay on the card and draws an underline under the title, and keyboard focus on the card's title link produces the same overlay and underline.
evaluation_rule: Open /afterglow/fr/ on a wide screen with a mouse and scroll to the section headed La collection. Yes when moving the pointer over the T-shirt graphique card brings up a visible overlay treatment on the card and an underline under the title, when the overlay and underline go away as the pointer leaves, when pointing at the Blanc swatch makes that swatch grow, and when pressing Tab until the title link of that card is focused brings up the same overlay and underline without any pointer. No when hovering changes nothing, when the underline appears without any overlay, or when keyboard focus on the title link shows only a focus ring with no overlay and no underline.

criterion: The Shop action in the fixed bar of the Afterglow English drop page is the only button-shaped control with an amber fill, visibly heavier than the menu button and the language switcher, with the amber wordmark in the centre counting as a logo.
evaluation_rule: Open /afterglow/en/ on a wide screen and look at the bar across the top. The wordmark in the centre is the Halden Sport logo and is not a button. Yes when the menu button sits at the left, the wordmark in the centre, and the language switcher then the Shop action at the right, when Shop is a filled amber button, when the menu button and the switcher are visibly lighter controls without an amber fill, when the wordmark is filled amber over a black outline shape, and when the bar and its controls stay readable while the page scrolls under it past the magenta and pink grounds. No when the wordmark is a plain dark logo, when a bar control becomes unreadable over a section ground, when the menu button or the switcher is filled in amber, when Shop looks like a plain text link, or when two controls in the bar look equally primary.

criterion: On the Afterglow French drop page the hero image begins as a small portrait window in the middle of the ground, opens outward in step with scrolling, and the stickers of the artist section fly up into place as that section arrives.
evaluation_rule: The stickers are the decorative bolts, arcs, speckled discs and stars; the artist section is the one headed Salut, je suis Tove Ardenne. Open /afterglow/fr/ with motion allowed and scroll down slowly from the top through the artist section. Yes when the hero image first appears as a narrow upright window centred in the ground, when the window grows wider and taller in proportion to the distance scrolled and shrinks again when scrolling back up, and when the artist section's stickers travel upward into their resting positions, some turning as they land, as the section comes into view. No when the hero image is full width from the first frame, when the window opens on a timer regardless of scrolling, or when the artist stickers are already in place before the section scrolls into view.

criterion: The tagline of the Afterglow French drop page appears letter by letter, the two collage photographs cross the headline on opposite diagonals, and the rows of the footer list replay one by one on entering the viewport.
evaluation_rule: Scroll /afterglow/fr/ slowly with motion allowed on a wide screen. Yes when the tagline À vos côtés depuis 1976 is revealed one character after another rather than as a block, when the two photographs in the collage travel across the giant headline in opposite directions, covering some of the words as they pass, when the four product cards of the section headed La collection arrive one after another in a short cascade, and when the numbered footer list rows [01] to [04] each animate into place in turn as they reach the viewport. No when the tagline appears whole, when the collage photographs stay still, or when all four footer rows are already in place before they scroll into view.

criterion: Keyboard focus on the Afterglow English drop page shows a visible focus ring on every menu item over the teal menu ground and on every swatch, drawn differently from the pointer hover look.
evaluation_rule: Open /afterglow/en/, open the menu with the keyboard, and Tab through the four menu items, then close the menu and Tab to the Pink and White swatches of the Graphic tee card. Yes when each focused menu item shows an outline or ring that stands out against the light muted teal ground, when each focused swatch shows a ring around the swatch, and when pointing at the same controls with a mouse produces a different effect from the focus ring. No when a focused item shows nothing, when the ring is invisible against the teal, or when focus and hover look identical.

criterion: At a phone width the studio campaign view stacks the campaign list above the market rows, and the menu button of the Afterglow French drop page shows its icon alone, with the word Menu dropped.
evaluation_rule: Use a viewport about 390 pixels wide. Sign in at /studio/login as owner@example.com with the password deku-demo-pw-2026 and open /studio/campaigns/afterglow/, then open /afterglow/fr/. Yes when the studio shows the campaign list as a block above the Afterglow market rows instead of beside them, and when the drop page's menu button at the left of the bar shows only its icon without the word Menu. No when the studio keeps the list and the market rows side by side at that width, or when the menu button still shows the word Menu at that width.
